description: Open a support case for an order (damaged / missing / wrong item, stain not removed, late delivery, re-clean, other). Works with the connected Fold account, or with order code + the email used at booking. A Fold specialist follows up by text or email; re-cleans are free. Describe what happened in the customer's words.

email.description: Email used at booking. Not needed with a connected account.

preferredResolution.description: Optional, e.g. "re-clean" or "refund for the shirt".

name: report_issue
title: Report a problem with an order
